Carmen Chan&#39;s Sampan photos

  • English
  • 简体中文
  • 繁體中文

collection

This collection contains photographs taken by Carmen Chan, a reporter for Chinatown's local newspaper Sampan. The collection contains a large number of black and white photos. Digitize issues of Sampan newspaper can be accessed through Northeastern University Archives & Special Collections.
